lines.text: Let's get the ball rolling with ideas.

data.define: To begin a project or process.

example.text: Let's get the ball rolling with ideas.

misuse.text: Don't say 'get the ball rolling' about finishing.

data.l1_hook: Pertemuan dimulai. Siapa yang duluan? "Get the ball rolling".
data.l1_ex: Mari "get the ball rolling" dengan ide-ide.

native.tip: “get the ball rolling” = memulai. Contoh: “Let's get the ball rolling with ideas.”
